items.title: Structuring a monorepo
body: Lay out several packages in one repository.
Declare the workspace globs in the root manifest:
Cross-package imports resolve through the workspace, so `cli` can import
`core` by name without a build step. Add a dependency by naming it in the
consuming package's manifest and re-running install; the resolver links
the local copy instead of fetching from the registry. Keep versions in
step across packages or the linker falls back to the registry copy.

items.title: Managing workspace dependencies
body: Share code between packages in one repository.
Declare the workspace globs in the root manifest:
A package depends on a sibling by naming it in its own manifest and
re-running install; the resolver links the local copy rather than
fetching the published one. Because the link is by name, `cli` imports
`core` with no build step in between.
Keep versions aligned across packages — a drifted range makes the resolver
prefer the registry copy, and you get two copies of `core` at runtime.
